mapper.insert: insert into ee_verify_record(user_id, verify_type, verify_result, verify_content, verify_no, ip_address, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{verifyType}, #{verifyResult}, #{verifyContent}, #{verifyNo}, #{ipAddress}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select record_id, user_id, verify_type, verify_result, verify_content, verify_no, ip_address, create_time from ee_verify_record where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select record_id, user_id, verify_type, verify_result, verify_content, verify_no, ip_address, create_time from ee_verify_record where verify_type = #{verifyType} order by create_time desc
